title: bl_selfcheck.host_commands treats a forge set by a settings layer as unset
goal: bl_selfcheck.host_commands compares the forge setting's source with the string file, so a forge that the backlog object of a settings layer sets (source 'clone, settings.json') gets no forge commands allowed; it tests the source is not default

run: import sys,tempfile,pathlib,json;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_base,bl_selfcheck;d=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());(d/'settings.json').write_text(json.dumps({'backlog':{'forge':'github'}}));sys.exit(0 if any(c.startswith('gh') for c in bl_selfcheck.host_commands(d)) else 1)
